title: Batch Pipeline and Brew-Day Cadence
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brew:fermentation
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats dc(batch) as batches by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many batches you start each month, revealing the rhythm of your brewing hobby over the year.
value: Seeing your brew-day cadence shows whether the hobby is thriving or stalled, and helps plan ingredient buying ahead.
implementation: Ingest fermentation records tagged by batch; schedule monthly and count distinct batches started.
visualization: Column chart of batches started per month.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how often you brew each month, showing whether your hobby is busy or has gone quiet.
